phrase: A new safety law now requires AI labs to report bad behavior. One lab preparing a trillion-dollar stock sale is warning that its own technology could be catastrophic.
phraseAlternatives: New safety rules now ask AI labs to report what goes wrong. One of them just priced a trillion-dollar stock sale anyway.
A safety law takes effect requiring AI labs to disclose risk. One lab's reply was a $1.4 trillion stock offering.
Regulators want AI labs to confess their dangers. One lab confessed, then sold shares worth $1.4 trillion.
AI labs must now report their own risks under a new law. One priced its IPO at $1.4 trillion the same week.
alt: A company's data-center building stands beside a government official holding a sign that reads "safety report," while a red rocket labeled "$1.4T" shoots into the sky with a small "catastrophic" tag fluttering off its tail, and a cheerful founder walks away carrying a money bag.

brief.concept: A company signs a freshly enforced safety-disclosure form with one hand while launching its own stock into a trillion-dollar orbit with the other, a tiny catastrophe warning fluttering off the back of the rocket.
brief.metaphor: Regulation and valuation arrive in the same envelope: a safety report in one hand, a trillion-dollar rocket in the other.

brief.composition: Split composition, left-right. Left half: the company building's open door, one paper-cutout hand reaching out to take a form stamped SAFETY REPORT from a government official standing at a small podium. Right half: the same building's other side launching the rocket-shaped $1.4T stock arrow upward past layered paper clouds, the small CATASTROPHIC tag fluttering off its tail. A founder figure walks off-panel at the bottom right, carrying a dollar-sign bag. Keep it to these four main elements, flat cut-paper layers, soft drop shadows.
